job.title: SAP S/4HANA Basis Administrator
job.description:
A Global IT services firm is seeking an S/4HANA Basis Administrator. As an S/4HANA Basis Administrator, you will be responsible for managing, maintaining, and supporting the S/4HANA landscape. Your focus will be on ensuring system stability, performance, and security, while enabling seamless integration with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services.
We are looking for a professional with in-depth knowledge of S/4HANA architecture, SAP BTP, and cloud-based SAP system management, along with strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Responsibilities:
- Manage the S/4HANA system landscape, including development, QA, and production environments
- Install, configure, and maintain S/4HANA systems and components, including Fiori Launchpad, embedded analytics, and other S/4HANA-specific functionalities
- Keep systems up to date and secure by applying SAP support packages, feature packs, and OSS notes
- Perform user administration, authorization assignments, and role management in S/4HANA environments
- Execute system refreshes, copies, and migrations, including S/4HANA conversion projects
- Configure and manage integration between S/4HANA and SAP BTP services such as SAP Integration Suite, SAP Extension Suite, and SAP Analytics Cloud
- Manage S/4HANA and SAP BTP environments deployed on cloud platforms
- Monitor system performance, identify areas for improvement, including HANA database performance
- Perform system tuning and optimization to enhance performance and stability
- Participate in S/4HANA implementation, upgrade, and migration projects
- Provide expertise and support on S/4HANA Basis topics to project teams
- Create and maintain documentation related to S/4HANA Basis
- Stay up to date on the latest S/4HANA Basis technologies, SAP BTP services, and best practices for cloud-based SAP management
- Identify and implement opportunities to improve S/4HANA Basis processes and procedures

Required Skills:
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation projects
- Experience in migration projects from ECC to S/4HANA
- Hands-on experience in the installation, configuration, and maintenance of S/4HANA systems
- Advanced technical knowledge of S/4HANA architecture, SAP NetWeaver, and HANA database administration
- SAP S/4HANA System Administration certification
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Why should you apply:
- Great opportunity to be able to work for well-established company
- Cross-departmental communication is possible in an international environment

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
A Global IT Service firm is looking for a Data Engineer for its AI & Data Division. This division is responsible for the AI products such as chatbots, voicebots, and copilot tools to support human operators.
You'll join a 60-person AI for Customer Service team of engineers, scientists, data analysts, and dialogue designers, responsible for modernizing legacy contact-center tooling and workloads into an agentic Generative AI stack. This role is responsible for the entire data backbone of a V1 product: pipelines, storage, and the data platform that our analysts and product managers will depend on from day one.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and own the data infrastructure for the V1 CCaaS product, from ingestion through serving, supporting the business unit's analytics needs
- Develop and operate production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines with orchestration tools, ingesting and transforming the large volumes of data generated by chatbot events and customer journey interactions
- Architect and optimize cloud data warehouse datasets across medallion-style layers (raw bronze, cleansed silver, aggregated gold), with partitioning, clustering, and SQL tuning for large-scale analytical workloads
- Design event-centric data models at session and turn grain that serve both operational features and analytical reporting, keeping the product's operational layer and analytical layer consistent
- Keep every pipeline reliably dependable in production through data quality checks, monitoring, and observability, so analysts and product managers can trust the numbers they see on dashboards
- Partner with Data Analysts and Product Managers to understand data needs. Requests typically start as one-off extractions and are iterated into scalable, reusable data products as demand grows or as they feed into the main pipeline
- Integrate real-time or near-real-time data streams as the product's event volume grows
- Establish data governance fundamentals: standardized event definitions, schemas, and naming conventions across all smart agents so their data stays comparable and combinable, plus documentation, lineage, and access control appropriate for an early-stage, fast-moving team

Required skills:
- Over 5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including building and operating production data pipelines
- Advanced SQL and strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python or Go
- Experience with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks, including performance tuning at scale
- Experience with ETL/ELT orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, or Google Cloud Dataflow
- Experience designing analytics data models and data marts (e.g., dimensional modeling, dbt or similar) across layered architectures (medallion bronze/silver/gold), owning their quality and documentation
- Familiarity with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Pub/Sub for real-time ingestion
- Experience building data infrastructure from scratch (greenfield or V1 product context) rather than only maintaining existing platforms
- Experience partnering with analysts, product managers, or engineers to deliver reliable, reusable data solutions
- Ability to design data solutions robust enough to absorb the ambiguity and changing requirements typical of V1 product development in a fast-paced, agile environment

Why should you apply:
- Great opportunity to be able to work for well-established company
- Cross-departmental communication is possible in an international environment

job.title: Security Operations Engineer (SOC / Detection & Automation) (8416)
job.description:
A Global IT Service firm is seeking a Security Operations Engineer (SOC / Detection & Automation) to support the full System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and operation security for the services developed inside the Group, with dedicated security teams and operation centers in key regions worldwide.
The team monitors and investigates production alerts, builds detections and automation, and responds to incidents, working closely with product and platform development teams.

Responsibilities:
- Alert monitoring: Monitor and triage alerts from production sources such as server and host logs, EDR and runtime security agents on servers and containers, container and Kubernetes audit logs, network intrusion detection, web application firewall and DNS logs, and vulnerability or posture findings
- Threat analysis: Separate genuine threats from false positives, including suspicious process and command execution, privilege escalation, unusual outbound connections, exploitation of public-facing services, and container or Kubernetes abuse
- Incident response: Take part in investigation, containment, and recovery for production incidents. Escalate within the team for incident management coordination, and to platform or application teams where root cause needs their involvement
- Incident documentation: Document incidents, triage findings, and escalation rationale clearly and accurately, so handoffs are clean
- Proactive threat hunting: Analyse logs, traffic patterns, and system telemetry to find sophisticated threats that bypass signature-based defences
- Alert tuning: Identify false positive patterns across alert volume and propose changes to SIEM detection queries, following the team's approval workflow rather than editing production rules directly
- Detection development: Develop, tune, and maintain high-fidelity detection rules across SIEM, EDR, and other security tools. Suggest new rules and analysis approaches based on observed gaps, and map detections to MITRE ATT&CK
- Correlation and enrichment: Combine data sources (for example network, web, DNS, and host telemetry) to enrich alerts and reduce investigation time
- Response automation: Design and implement automated workflows (SOAR) and scripts that respond to common threats and reduce manual work for the team
- Custom tooling: Build internal tools and scripts that close gaps in the security stack and improve visibility across the production environment
- CI/CD guardrails: Partner with SRE and DevOps teams to integrate automated security guardrails into CI/CD pipelines

Required Skills:
- 4+ years in a cyber security role (security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or security engineering) monitoring production environments
- Experience working with alerts or detections from a SIEM and from EDR, host, or network security tools
- Solid understanding of network protocols, OS internals (Linux and Windows), and web application architectures
- Working knowledge of containers and container orchestration (for example Kubernetes) sufficient to put audit log events in context, such as pods, namespaces, RBAC, and service accounts, without requiring engineering experience
- Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and how to map real-world activity to its tactics
- Comfortable working a shift or follow-the-sun rota and, where required, on-call responsibilities
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders in a cross-functional team
- Plus depth in at least one focus area: 1) Security operations focus or 2) Detection engineering and automation focus

Why should you apply:
- Contribute to strategic initiatives in the rapidly growing fields of AI and technology
- Gain broad experience through projects spanning diverse technology and business areas
- Work with global teams and stakeholders, leveraging both Japanese and English

A leading global technology and telecommunications company with operations worldwide. The company offers a diverse range of digital and technology-related businesses and continues to expand its global service ecosystem through ongoing investment in AI and digital transformation.

job.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Lead
job.description:
One of the world’s largest financial services companies is seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Lead to lead the planning, analysis, and delivery of cyber threat intelligence that enables the organization to anticipate and respond effectively to the evolving cyber threat landscape.
In this role, you will analyze internal security telemetry, including logs and alerts, alongside external threat intelligence sources to identify significant threats, assess adversary behaviors, and evaluate potential business impact.
The purpose of this position is to enable the organization to make risk-based security decisions and respond to emerging threats rapidly and effectively.

Responsibilities:
- Serve as the Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Lead for Japan
- Lead CTI activities across the company's Japan-based group companies, incorporating Japanese-language intelligence, region-specific threat actors, and regulatory considerations into analysis
- Enhance globally sourced threat intelligence by contextualizing it to the Japanese and regional environment
- Lead the collection and analysis of intelligence in local languages, including Japanese, and drive continuous tracking of Japan- and APAC-specific threat actors and campaigns
- Identify and clarify the cyber threat intelligence requirements of the CISO/Information Security Office (ISO) and business functions
- Deliver threat intelligence in a format that enables effective decision-making by stakeholders at all levels, from senior executives and business leaders to security and other technical teams
- Continuously incorporate feedback from intelligence consumers to improve relevance, communication, measurement of business impact, and overall intelligence quality
- Analyze a wide range of internal and external telemetry and intelligence sources to identify emerging threat indicators, adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and global and regional threat trends
- Produce high-quality intelligence reports that support strategic, operational, and tactical decision-making, clearly communicating risk assessments and recommended actions and translating intelligence into practical defensive measures
- Prioritizing and recommending improvements to detection rules
- Supporting hypothesis development for Threat Hunting activities
- Identifying gaps in existing security controls and opportunities to strengthen defenses
- Work closely with Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Incident Response, and Technology teams to plan and lead intelligence-driven defensive activities from strategy through execution
- Deliver clear and concise intelligence briefings to technical teams and senior leadership, ensuring key insights can be understood and acted upon quickly
- Establish and continuously enhance CTI processes and workflows to build a scalable, measurable, and business-relevant operating model
- Promote and utilize structured analytical frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Diamond Model, integrating insights from threat emulation, incident response, and other analytical activities
- Support defensive teams in prioritizing monitoring and response activities based on intelligence-driven assessments
- Build and maintain relationships with industry organizations such as FS-ISAC, security vendors, and regional intelligence communities to strengthen information-sharing capabilities

Required Skills:
- Cross-domain security telemetry analysis: Proven experience analyzing multiple security telemetry sources, including SIEM, XDR/EDR, network- and host-based detection systems, firewall logs, and system logs. Ability to go beyond event analysis to assess the intelligence significance of threats and translate findings into defensive priorities
- Strong understanding of SaaS and cloud environments: Deep knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, as well as enterprise SaaS environments, including how adversaries exploit identities and authentication/authorization mechanisms, APIs, integrations, and misconfigurations
- Comprehensive understanding of the intelligence lifecycle: Strong understanding of intelligence requirements, collection, analysis, dissemination, and feedback. Practical experience applying structured analytical methodologies such as Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH) and the Diamond Model, with the ability to produce evidence-based assessments and clearly communicate confidence levels
- Advanced knowledge and practical experience with MITRE frameworks, with the ability to apply them to actual defensive design and operations
- Cyber Resiliency Engineering Framework (CREF): Incorporating cyber resilience considerations into defensive strategies
- Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIR): Experience defining and managing PIRs based on stakeholder priorities and challenges, and continuously adjusting collection, analysis, and intelligence outputs in response to changes in the threat environment
- Agile / iterative working experience: Ability to prioritize intelligence activities, balance multiple competing requirements, and drive delivery of meaningful outcomes in a fast-paced environment
- Continuous learning and adaptability: Demonstrated ability to independently keep pace with changes in adversary behavior, emerging technologies, and attack techniques, and apply that knowledge to improve intelligence quality and strengthen defensive capabilities
- Strong collaboration and external engagement skills: Proven experience working with internal and external stakeholders, industry organizations, and external partners to increase the value and impact of cyber threat intelligence

Why should you apply:
- Apply your expertise in Cyber Threat Intelligence to influence security strategies across Japan and the global organization.
- Leverage MITRE ATT&CK and other intelligence frameworks to translate threat intelligence into practical, threat-informed defensive strategies.
- Work across Threat Analysis, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, and Incident Response to drive the continuous enhancement of the organization's defensive capabilities

job.title: IT Network Architect & Operations Lead
job.description:

This position provides technical leadership across campus, WAN, data center, cloud and internet connectivity, while partnering with international IT teams, cybersecurity, business functions and service providers.

Responsibilities:

- Routing, IP and connectivity: Define global IP addressing and routing architecture, including BGP, OSPF, route policies, network segmentation, traffic engineering, and connectivity across campus, WAN, internet, data centers and cloud platforms
- Core network services: Set design, ownership, lifecycle and operating standards for proxy services, DNS, DHCP, IP Address Management (IPAM/DDI) and other core network products
- Security and partner integration: Establish secure technical patterns for connecting suppliers, business partners, joint ventures and external services using SASE, secure web gateway, zero-trust access, proxies, DNS, firewalls, segmentation and network security controls
- Availability, resilience and operations: Govern high-availability and failover architecture, documented recovery scenarios, resilience testing, capacity planning, network monitoring and remediation initiatives
- Transformation and incident leadership: Lead technical coordination of global network changes, migrations and service improvements. During critical incidents, direct technical recovery, lead root cause analysis (RCA), and track corrective actions through closure
- Service performance and suppliers: Define service health, availability, capacity, resilience and technical-risk KPIs; manage architectural risks, dependencies, technical debt, budgets and supplier deliverables

Required Skills:
- 8+ years of professional enterprise networking experience, including several years as a Network Architect or Senior Network Engineer; proven experience designing and governing networks for medium-to-large enterprises
- Deep technical knowledge of BGP, OSPF, IP addressing, route policies, network segmentation, traffic engineering, WAN, campus/data center/cloud connectivity and IP address management
- Strong understanding of SASE and network security, including secure web gateways, zero-trust access, firewalls, remote access, cloud security integration, DNS and proxy services
- Experience integrating external partners, suppliers, joint ventures or acquired entities into enterprise network and security environments
- Hands-on operational understanding of network monitoring, performance management, capacity planning, configuration management, automation and network operations tools
- Experience leading global infrastructure transformations, technical migrations, cross-team delivery and vendor/supplier management
- Knowledge of IT service management (ITSM): incident, problem, change and configuration management
- Enterprise-level architecture judgment balancing global standards, security, resilience, costs and local business requirements
- Strong stakeholder management, structured governance, prioritization and documentation; ability to explain technical risks and decisions to engineers, management and business leaders
- Ownership mindset and ability to coordinate across global, regional, multicultural and supplier teams

- Own major technical decisions across routing, network security, connectivity and network services
- Collaborate with an international infrastructure organization and drive complex network modernization projects

The role focuses primarily on software development and system integration (approximately 70%), with the remaining 30% dedicated to infrastructure troubleshooting, production support, and technical problem-solving.
The successful candidate will design, develop, and maintain backend applications, APIs, middleware, and automated solutions supporting payment processing and financial messaging workflows. Candidates should have experience in either SWIFT technology or AML (Anti-Money Laundering) / payment gateway systems, together with strong software development and integration skills.

- Build automation tools to improve payment processing, monitoring, validation, and operational efficiency

- API & Integration: Experience developing REST/SOAP APIs, microservices, middleware, and enterprise system integrations
- Messaging & Data Formats: Experience with XML, XSD, XSLT, JSON, and message transformation or routing

job.title: Messaging Backend Engineer - Distributed Systems
job.description:
A Top IT Tech firm is growing and looking for a Backend Engineer for their distributed systems across the entire Platform. In this role you will be working with a dedicated team to help improves overall services across various domains. This is an opportunity to work on systems at a scale that are rare to see in Japan and work with other dedicated engineers in a collaborate results focused environment.

The focus is on the backend development with strong emphasis on distributed systems and storage technologies. You will be involved in the design, development, and operation of distributed data infrastructure such as Redis, Apache HBase, and next-generation distributed databases (YugabyteDB, etc.), ensuring high performance, consistency, and fault tolerance in large-scale environments. This position goes beyond mere feature development; you will directly impact the long-term evolution of the platform by participating in architecture design and technology selection for large-scale distributed systems. Opportunities to work with distributed systems of this scale are extremely rare globally.

Responsibilities:
- You will design and implement server-side functionalities and robust data structures for large-scale data storage, with a focus on distributed processing, fault tolerance, and scalability
- You will identify and improve bottlenecks to ensure stable performance even in high-traffic environments, and promote continuous optimization of system characteristics
- Optimizing the use of distributed databases, and developing storage-critical functions in messaging and related services
- You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including SREs and other backend teams, to drive improvements in data consistency, reliability, scalability, and observability across our entire backend service
- Long-term architectural strategy and consideration and promotion of next-generation distributed storage (e.g., multi-datacenter active-active configuration, NewSQL database integration, etc.)
- You will provide leadership services for addressing challenges in production environments (such as fault response, performance degradation, and scaling issues), from root cause analysis to recurrence prevention
- Promoting initiatives to improve CI/CD workflows, test coverage, and system monitoring
- Depending on the team and component, this may include on-call support to ensure 24/7 service availability

Required Skills:
- Fundamental knowledge of computer science, including algorithms, data structures, networks, and parallel processing
- Practical experience in server-side development (3 years or more)
- Team development experience
- A strong interest in distributed storage middleware and the ability to logically analyze the challenges in highly concurrent and distributed architectures (we use Apache HBase, Redis, and YugabyteDB, but prior experience with these technologies is not required)
- Experience in designing and implementing systems that take into account non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, and availability, or an equivalent understanding
- English reading and writing skills for technical and cross-functional communication (business level not required)

As a senior decision-maker during incident response, you will assess and direct the handling of escalated incidents while, over the medium to long term, leading initiatives to mature the overall Incident Response program across processes, organizational capabilities, and technology.
A key part of this role is developing the technical capabilities and careers of team members. Through internal training, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and other development initiatives, you will help build and maintain a highly skilled and specialized team.
Success in this role requires not only deep technical expertise, but also the ability to assess and organize complex situations from a broader perspective, build consensus across stakeholders, demonstrate inclusive leadership, and continuously learn and adapt to evolving threats and technologies.

Responsibilities:
- Partner with group life insurance companies, the Information Security Office (ISO), and global technology teams to oversee and coordinate cyber incident response, ensuring timely and business-impact-aware handling of incidents
- Serve as the final decision-maker for critical incidents escalated from the Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC), business functions, and external partners
- Establish and enhance organizational capabilities and maturity initiatives to embed effective incident response capabilities into new business processes and technology implementations
- Manage the full lifecycle of investigations, ensuring that documentation, reporting, evidence management, and chain of custody are properly maintained in accordance with regulatory and audit requirements
- Lead cross-functional risk management in collaboration with Technology, Legal, Privacy, Communications, and other relevant functions, covering both cyber and business risks
- Continuously drive process improvements and resilience initiatives through post-incident analysis, KPI measurement, and threat intelligence
- Leverage expertise in emerging technologies and evolving threat landscapes to guide investigation strategies and support the technical development and growth of the team
- Maintain and promote knowledge of cybersecurity principles, frameworks, and industry trends to ensure the organization maintains a leading level of incident response capability

Required Skills:
- 10+ years of hands-on experience in cyber incident response and digital forensics within a large enterprise or government organization, including experience with complex and distributed IT infrastructure environments
- 5+ years of experience as a technical team lead or manager, with a proven track record of developing team members, strengthening organizational capabilities, and improving operational quality
- Strong experience with identity platforms, including Entra ID (Azure AD) and Active Directory
- Strong experience with cloud platforms, including Azure and AWS
- Experience with Microsoft 365 environments
- Strong knowledge of Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems
- Advanced query and detection engineering skills across SIEM, EDR, and detection platforms, including hands-on experience designing and operating detection logic and investigation queries using SPL, KQL, or similar technologies
- Practical experience developing scripts and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages for investigation, incident response, and operational improvement
- Extensive hands-on experience with major digital forensics tools, including X-Ways, EnCase, KAPE, The Sleuth Kit, Volatility, or equivalent commercial/open-source tools
- Ability to clearly communicate investigation findings, technical risks, and business implications in both Japanese and English to technical professionals as well as senior executives
- Proven experience developing practical detection, investigation, and response strategies based on adversary tactics and techniques, using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain

Why should you apply:
- Join a team where every individual's perspective is valued and where your work can contribute to improving people's experiences and everyday lives

job.title: Digital Forensic Investigator
job.description:
One of the world’s largest financial services companies is seeking a Digital Forensics Investigator to join its cybersecurity organization. As a highly specialized technical professional in Japan, the Digital Forensics Investigator will be responsible for the analysis and response activities related to digital forensics and incident response (DFIR). You will conduct investigations following security incidents, support threat hunting activities, and contribute to the development and enhancement of the organization’s incident response capabilities, as well as other cybersecurity-related activities as required, within a global and rapidly evolving corporate environment.This role requires the ability to assess situations and data from multiple perspectives and solve highly complex problems, including those involving factors that may not have clearly defined metrics or objective decision criteria. We are looking for someone who can work effectively in an agile environment, apply sound business judgment, embrace diversity and different perspectives, and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous learning.

Responsibilities
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders, including group life insurance companies, the Information Security Office (ISO), and global technology teams, to support and coordinate cyber incident response activities on a global scale
- Conduct complex, enterprise-scale investigations across hybrid environments, including on-premises and cloud environments such as Active Directory / Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure, and AWS
- Leverage SIEM and detection platforms to conduct efficient, data-driven investigations using advanced query techniques, including Splunk Search Processing Language (SPL) and Microsoft Kusto Query Language (KQL)
- Utilize Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) technologies to perform large-scale endpoint investigations, threat hunting, triage, and root cause analysis (RCA) across distributed environments
- Perform comprehensive digital forensic analysis across multiple domains, including log analysis, host-based forensics, memory analysis, and network traffic analysis, to support incident response activities
- Conduct triage and analysis of malicious code to identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), behavioral patterns, and potential impact, contributing to containment and recovery strategies
- Organize and communicate investigation findings in a clear, concise, and actionable manner, including the preparation of high-quality investigation reports and verbal briefings for both technical professionals and senior business leaders
- Develop and maintain scripts, detection queries, and automated workflows using tools such as XSOAR to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of incident response activities
- Lead or actively contribute to strategic initiatives and continuous improvement activities aimed at strengthening forensic, detection, and incident response capabilities across the enterprise

Required Skills:
- 5+ years of hands-on experience in cyber incident response and digital forensics within large and complex enterprise environments, including experience working in global organizations or geographically distributed environments
- Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts, investigation findings, and risk implications in both Japanese and English to technical teams as well as business stakeholders, including non-technical audiences
- Hands-on experience with digital forensics tools such as X-Ways and EnCase, including either commercial or open-source tools
- Foundational to practical-level knowledge and experience in scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies, including experience improving investigation efficiency, performing data analysis, or automating response activities
- Strong understanding of attacker behaviors and Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), with practical experience applying frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain to detection, investigation, and incident response activities

Why should you apply:
- Join a team and culture where your perspectives are valued and where your work can make a meaningful difference to people's experiences and everyday lives.
- Build on your existing expertise while gaining opportunities to strengthen both your technical and leadership capabilities. We support continuous learning so that you can create an even greater impact.
- Discover the career possibilities offered by a strong and well-established organization while working on meaningful cybersecurity challenges and initiatives.

job.title: Senior AI Engineer (LLM Adoption)
job.description:
A Global IT Service firm is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join the LLM Adoption Department (LLMAD) within the AI & Data Division (AIDD).
You will be responsible for designing, building, evaluating, and deploying production-grade AI agents and LLM-powered applications that solve real business problems and accelerate the use of in-house AI capabilities across the firm ecosystem.

Responsibilities:
- Own a business unit engagement end to end, embed in their engineering team, design the agent (task decomposition, tool and function calling, multi-step orchestration, state, retrieval, guardrails), and write production code in their codebase
- Take agents from prototype to production and own what that requires: latency, cost, failure modes, and monitoring, including the judgment to say early when an agent is the wrong answer and a prompt, a fine-tune, or plain software is not
- Select the right in-house or open-source model for each task and prove it with task-level evaluation rather than benchmark scores, building the evaluation sets and harnesses together with the business unit
- Run migrations from third-party APIs to our in-house models, including parity testing, prompt porting, staged cutover, and feeding the gaps you find back to our model and platform teams
- Own prompt and context engineering as a discipline: structured output, tool schemas, retrieval strategy, and caching, versioned and measured against evaluations. Debug quality problems down to whether the fault is the prompt, the retrieval, the model, or the data
- Turn the work into cookbooks, recipes, and reference implementations that other business units can lift directly, and raise the bar around you through code review, mentorship, and hands-on enablement for business unit engineers

Required skills:
- Over 6 years of professional software engineering experience, with recent hands-on focus on building LLM applications. You are shipping this work today
- Proven agentic engineering experience: you have built, shipped, evaluated, and debugged agents in production, including tool and function calling, multi-step orchestration, and the failure modes that come with them
- Prompt and context engineering as a discipline, including structured outputs, systematic iteration against evaluations, and versioning
- Practical model knowledge: the strengths and weaknesses of open-weight and commercial models, when to fine-tune versus prompt versus retrieve, and the cost and latency trade-offs of each
- Solid production fundamentals: APIs, backend services, testing, observability, and experience with self-hosted or cloud inference (e.g., vLLM)
- Able to work embedded in someone else's engineering team, communicate directly with business stakeholders, and operate with the ambiguity of a function that is still being defined
- Writes things down: documentation, examples, and recipes that other engineers can actually use.

Why should you apply:
- Drive AI adoption across one of the world's most diverse digital ecosystems, serving businesses in e-commerce, fintech, digital content, and communications
- Own end-to-end delivery of production AI solutions, from problem definition and agent design to deployment, evaluation, and optimization
- Work hands-on with cutting-edge LLMs, AI agents, retrieval systems, and open-source models at enterprise scale
- Influence AI adoption beyond a single product by creating reusable frameworks, cookbooks, and best practices used across multiple business units
- Collaborate directly with business and engineering leaders to solve high-impact challenges and shape the future of AI

job.title: AI Engineer (LLM Adoption)
job.description:

You will collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to build, deploy, evaluate, and optimize LLM-powered features and agent workflows in production.

- Curiosity about how models behave. You want to understand why an output was wrong, not just retry it

This position offers a rare opportunity to co-create a startup alongside a confirmed CEO, supported by the capital, network, and expertise of an established investment firm. As the founding CTO, you will take full ownership of the technology strategy and execution—from ideation to prototype development, and eventually scaling the product and building a high-performing engineering team.
The role is highly hands-on at the initial stage, requiring you to directly engage in coding, architecture design, and product development, while also acting as a key partner in shaping business strategy and communicating with investors. You will be expected to bridge the gap between technology and business, ensuring the product is both technically robust and commercially successful in global markets.

- Lead the end-to-end development of a global education game application (focused on language learning and skill enhancement)
- Build the product from scratch, including hands-on coding, architecture design, and system implementation
- Develop initial prototypes / MVP independently before scaling the engineering team
- Collaborate closely with the CEO to define product vision, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy
- Communicate effectively with investors and stakeholders, presenting technical concepts and progress
- Establish and scale the future engineering organization, including hiring and team building
- Drive technical decisions across infrastructure, development frameworks, and AI integration where applicable

Required Skills:
- Strong hands-on engineering capability with experience building products from scratch in a startup or new business environment
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in a zero-to-one setting and communicate effectively with both business leaders and investors
- Experience in mobile / scalable application development with a global perspective (AI and gaming experience are a plus)

Why should you apply:
- Opportunity to co-found and architect a venture-backed startup from inception
- Direct collaboration with an experienced CEO and Venture firm
- Build a global-facing product with significant market potential
- Significant equity upside through stock options aligned with future IPO
- End-to-end ownership of technology, product, and team building
- Be part of a leading investment firm’s venture studio initiative

Company Details:
A leading Japan-based private equity firm with a strong track record of investing in and transforming mid-sized businesses. Renowned for its hands-on investment philosophy, the firm partners closely with management teams to drive operational excellence, accelerate growth, and create long-term value. Building on its success in private equity, the firm is expanding into venture creation and company building. By collaborating with experienced operators, entrepreneurs, and industry specialists, it is launching new ventures from the ground up, combining investment capital, strategic guidance, operational expertise, and technology-driven innovation to develop the next generation of high-growth businesses.

job.description:
A Global Insurance firm is seeking an experienced Technical Security Assurance Specialist to join their cybersecurity team.

- Hands-on experience validating the implementation and effectiveness of security controls across applications, infrastructure, and enterprise environments
- Strong understanding of network security, including network segmentation, firewalls, secure network architecture, and access controls
- Experience assessing encryption, privileged access management (PAM), identity and access management (IAM), authentication/authorization, and data masking controls
- Knowledge of vulnerability assessment methodologies, risk analysis, and remediation planning
- Familiarity with security frameworks and industry standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, PCI DSS, and CIS Controls

job.title: アカウント エグゼクティブ （営業）
job.url: https://www.skillhouse.co.jp/job-details/アカウント-エグゼクティブ-営業-in-internal-jobs-1498216
job.description:
職務詳細
営業部門のチームメンバーとして、関東圏の企業にIT人材やサービスを提供する役割を担っていただきます。主な業務内容は以下の通りです。
• 新規顧客に対するビジネス開発
• 既存顧客に対するアカウントとリレーションシップの管理
• クライアントへのIT人材サービスの販売プロセスの管理

アカウントエグゼクティブの役割は、人材サービス提供プロセスをリードすることです。新規顧客を開拓した後は、他のチームが顧客のニーズを満たすために必要なリソースの提供を担当します。そのため、このポジションには、ビジネス開発と顧客との良好な関係構築マネジメントのスキルと経験が求められます。さらに、リソースが必要な期間と予算内で提供されるように、他チームとの連携したコミュニケーションを取ることも求められます。

必須要項
• 5年以上の法人営業経験
• 優れたアカウント管理能力
• 優れた顧客関係管理能力
• 優れたビジネス開発スキルと経験
• 英語で中級レベルのコミュニケーション
• 前向きで外向的、エネルギッシュな方
• 優れたコミュニケーションスキル（口頭・文書ともに）
• チームワークを得意とする方


労働時間: 7:30AM～9:00AMフレックス開始（1日8時間勤務）、週1日在宅勤務（WFH）オプションあり。


企業情報
スキルハウス・スタッフィング・ソリューションズ株式会社（スキルハウス）は、IT関連に特化した、専門性の高い人材サービスを提供しています。

２つの専門分野に総力を結集しているため、スキルハウスならではの画期的な方法による人材評価、テスト、適正診断、マッチングを行い、求人企業のお客様に最良の人材をご紹介します。

人材派遣・紹介のプロであるスタッフが、理想の人材を、必要な時に、予算内でお客様にご紹介します。
job.salary: 15,200,000 OTE (年収720万円スタート＋コミッション、営業成績により最大年収800万円)＋インセンティブ、社会保険完備、交通費、確定拠出年金、年次有給休暇等

job.title: Linux Systems Administrator
job.description:
A Global Financial firm is seeking a Linux Systems Administrator, to join a special infrastructure team providing dedicated production support for mission critical Linux systems, ensuring high availability, performance and security. Supporting the Equity business unit’s systems including but not limited to COLO/DMZ infrastructure used for high frequency/ low latency trading, you will monitor & troubleshoot systems, manage deployments and patches, automate operational tasks, & work closely with infrastructure, application & business teams to resolve incidents & drive continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:
- Provide production support for COLO/DMZ infrastructure supporting high-frequency, low-latency trading systems
- Collaborate with HFT developers, project managers, and support teams to deliver solutions within tight timelines
- Work directly with the HFT trading desk and occasionally join client calls to translate requirements into technical solutions for COLO environments
- Participate in and lead exchange connectivity build-out projects when required
- Work independently and collaborate with global teams across Asia, Europe, and the US
- Ensure system stability and availability through troubleshooting, incident response, escalation, and root cause analysis
- Perform system administration tasks including installation, configuration, patching, monitoring, performance tuning, capacity planning, and DR testing
- Partner with Cross Platform Engineering to define operational requirements and deliver infrastructure solutions
- Manage system changes following change management procedures, including testing, approvals, deployment, and validation
- Ensure compliance with IT security, audit, and regulatory standards
- Manage vendor support cases and drive resolution
- Maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, procedures, and runbooks

Required Skills:
- Strong knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 8+) on bare metal
- Exp. with latency optimization, capacity planning, & performance tuning on bare metal (RHEL)
- Scripting experience in Shell, Python, Perl, or Ansible
- Hands-on experience with UNIX core services (e.g., LDAP, Kerberos, Ansible Tower)
- Familiarity with DevOps and telemetry tools
- 5+ years of UNIX/Linux support experience
- Strong knowledge of high-performance computing on HPE or similar servers, including BIOS and firmware tuning for low latency
- Familiarity with low-latency networking stacks (e.g., Solarflare, Onload, PTP)
- Experience with time-server technologies (e.g., Meinberg GPS receivers or equivalent)
- Knowledge of DNS/DHCP management tools (e.g., BlueCat or similar)
- Understanding of network firewalls

Why Should You Apply
- Join a flexible, diverse, and international Tokyo-based Platform & Cloud Services team
- Work on public/private cloud, Linux/Windows compute, and core infrastructure
- Contribute to both day-to-day operations (BAU) and large-scale, multi-year enterprise projects


Company Details
A global financial services leader with a diverse Japan IT team supporting retail and wholesale operations. Offers competitive benefits, career development, and a strong focus on diversity, inclusion, and employee well-being.

Working Hours: 8:40-17:40 (Mon-Fri), out of hours, weekend as needed
Working Style: Hybrid (currently 1day in-office, 4 days WFH, subject to change)
Holidays: Saturday, Sunday, National Holidays, Year-end and New Year Holidays, Paid Holidays, Other Special Holidays
Services/Benefits: Social insurance, employee pension, and commuting allowance, etc
